turns.customer: Hi, we just moved to Cedar Park and have never used a boarding place. Our pup Ziggy is 30 lbs.
blocks:
Welcome to Cedar Park! For a 30-lb dog like Ziggy, Happy Tails lists Standard and Luxury Suites; Tiny Town is for dogs 25 lb and under. Standard suites have indoor/outdoor accommodations, raised beds, private patios, and several potty walks daily. Luxury adds a larger room, TV, premium bedding, and a live 24-hour webcam.

Published rates are **$65/day for Standard** and **$90/day for Luxury**. Boarding is billed by the day, and the full-day charge applies regardless of drop-off time. Reservations are required. Dogs need written veterinary proof of Rabies, Distemper/Parvo, and Bordetella vaccinations; Bordetella must be within the last 6–12 months, and the resort recommends vaccinations be given two weeks before boarding.

Share Ziggy’s check-in and checkout dates and whether you prefer Standard or Luxury, and I can estimate the stay. I can also go over what to pack or other first-time boarding policies.

turns.customer: We're new! Can we use the First Stay & Play offer for 3 nights in a luxury suite for our pup Ziggy, Jan 26 to 29 2027?
blocks:

It’s subject to availability, participation may vary by resort, and the free play is a group-play evaluation only—not individual play. The offer terms don’t describe three nights in a Luxury Suite as free; any upgrade is paid by the customer.
